description: Scoring parameters extracted verbatim from the original HTML generator's JavaScript. Kept separate from scoring_config.json for comparison and audit; the Python app does not read this file. Band boundaries reproduce the HTML comparisons exactly: 'min'/'max' are inclusive, 'min_exclusive'/'max_exclusive' are exclusive. Values are not range-checked or prorated by the HTML.

PEG.metric: Mean of the first 3 numbers on the 'PEG:' line, or a pasted 'PEG ... x / 10' average; not rounded (displayed to 2 decimals)

item9.positive_label: Positive SI item; risk assessment indicated

ORT.metric: Pasted total; one scale for every ORT version (no ORT-OUD distinction). A level word on the 'ORT:' line overrides the computed level.

COMM.metric: Pasted total; accepted as '/ 64', '/ 68' or '/ 28', and the >= 9 threshold is applied to all of them

UDS/PDMP.not_reviewed: Not reviewed / not available at time of assessment
UDS/PDMP.consistent: Consistent with prescribed medication regimen and no concerning PDMP findings
UDS/PDMP.uds_consistent_pdmp_ok: UDS consistent; PDMP review without concerning findings
UDS/PDMP.uds_pending_pdmp_ok: UDS pending; PDMP review without concerning findings
UDS/PDMP.requires_review: UDS/PDMP findings require provider review and closer monitoring
UDS/PDMP.discordant: Discordant UDS and/or concerning PDMP findings noted

Refill behavior.stable: Stable refill behavior without early refill pattern
Refill behavior.no_concerns: No concerning refill behavior reported at this interval
Refill behavior.intermittent: Intermittent refill timing concerns requiring monitoring
Refill behavior.early_or_escalation: Early refill request or dose-escalation request noted
Refill behavior.lost_stolen: Lost/stolen medication report or medication-management concern noted
Refill behavior.requires_review: Refill behavior requires provider review and closer monitoring

Clinical context.high_pain: High pain interference with ongoing opioid therapy
Clinical context.aberrancy_history: Documented history of opioid-related aberrant medication-use behavior

qhp_time_split.description: Fractions of total minutes, each rounded with a minimum of 1; feedback gets the remainder (minimum 0) and any rounding drift is added to documentation.
